UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private per-user MoneyFlow settings and tracking start cycle stored at /users/{userId}.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document path userId.

trackingStartCycle.description: ISO local date (YYYY-MM-24) representing the start date of the user's first tracked salary cycle.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version shared across Android and future web clients.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every write.

DayEntry.title: DayEntry
DayEntry.description: Single-date override record stored at /users/{userId}/dayEntries/{dateKey} where dateKey is local YYYY-MM-DD.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching parent userId.

date.description: Local India date in YYYY-MM-DD format matching the document ID.

workStatus.description: Attendance/work status valid for the chosen dayType.

exitTime.description: Optional actual exit time saved verbatim to the minute in 24h HH:mm format.

overtimeEnabled.description: Explicit overtime toggle; OT counts only when true on worked dates.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every write.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and tracking start configuration isolated by authenticated UID.

/users/{userId}/dayEntries/{dateKey}.description: One document per user and YYYY-MM-DD local date storing explicit day overrides.
